title: paeonia corallina subsp. russoi
intro: Paeonia corallina subsp. russoi, commonly known as the Russian peony, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Paeonia. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may help to soothe and calm the body, reducing stress and anxiety. Furthermore, Paeonia corallina subsp. russoi has been traditionally used to treat a range of health issues, including fever, pain, and skin conditions, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
